title: Concept: Vaadin development mode in a response
description: A Vaadin development-mode bootstrap in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The development bootstrap serves the widget sources, the theme files and the debug window, and it disables the production optimisations that make the client harder to inspect.
applicability: Deployments that render a Vaadin development-mode bootstrap into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The development bootstrap serves the widget sources, the theme files and the debug window, and it disables the production optimisations that make the client harder to inspect.
